errors.text_span: Die Importe sind als durchgezogene blaue Linie ohne Marker dargestellt;
errors.evidence: The blue line corresponds to imports, but the figure legend labels the blue line as 'Importe (linke Skala)'; this claim is consistent. However, the description later treats the violet line as exports, while the figure shows the purple/violet line labeled 'Exporte (linke Skala)'. No error here.
